title: Emmitt Smith's son EJ Smith among the local prospects who worked out for the Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Emmitt Smith's son EJ Smith among the local prospects who worked out for the Cowboys
sources.description: NFL teams are allowed to bring in local players for a workout that doesn't count toward the league-mandated 30-visit limit, and when the Cowboys bought in their local draft prospects to Dallas Day, Texas A&M running back EJ Smith was among the players in attendance.
